learning_objective: 🎯 We will try out super fun art games, do group projects, and mix colorful paints like little scientists!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Paints hold magic secrets! If we mix primary colors like yellow and blue together, they magically turn into a brand new green color.
Creating art with our friends is the best activity! Everyone can draw one small part on a giant chart paper to make one huge, beautiful masterpiece.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Handprint Garden
fun_activity.instructions: Dip your hands in washable watercolor and press them on paper! Once dry, use a green marker to add stems to turn your handprints into giant flowers.

quick_recap: ⭐ Mixing primary colors creates beautiful, brand new colors.
⭐ Doing art activities with friends is double the fun and teaches teamwork.
⭐ Getting a little messy with paints is just a part of being a great artist!
